column1: # Every statement the site makes about U-Board, its status, and where this repository backs it.
# Not published: it sits outside public/ and the build never reads it. test/claims.test.ts matches its ids against
# the data-claim ids in src/ (both ways) and checks that every ref exists. Change a sentence, change its row in the same commit.
# status: works = works today · design = how it is built (a principle or a boundary) · vision = a goal, not built yet · promise = an operating commitment
# ref: one or more repository paths, joined with " · ".

column4: Values on a background drawing, embedded elsewhere, read from the owning system when shown
Live unframed, stale dashed amber, disconnected dotted grey; reason and age in the text
Per-value quality, the four reasons, the age of a stale value, no whole-view error
Generic HTTP connector: static token/header or OAuth 2.0 client credentials, JSON Pointer, credentials server-side
Share link: read-only without sign-in, iframe embedding, optional expiry, revocation
The instance iyulab operates — an operating commitment, not something the code proves
One image with server, console and share viewer; PostgreSQL
The npm package @iyulab/u-board with the authoring view and the viewer
No symbol library, alarms, control output or screen navigation
Boards store binding references, not values
No warehouse charts or pivot tables
